text: Independent native-Windows verification of flop-labs/tclk PR #119 at exact head 857c3ba09696529038204417a5c43a522f377550 (base/main 5cc4ab93efbc8999a3a7e1471b639deca25998ea): under Node 24.18.0, npm 11.16.0, and Corepack pnpm 11.25.0, a fresh `npm install --ignore-scripts @flop-labs/tclk@0.1.0` exposed none of foldTranscript, findContractHandshake, parseTranscriptExport, transcriptRecord, verifyTranscriptRecord, or makeHeartbeat, and decodeFrame rejected an otherwise shaped reveal carrying optional ref with `tclk: unknown field on reveal: ref`. Building exact main from checkout exposed all six APIs, preserved reveal.ref, and the focused upstream reveal/refund compatibility case passed 1/1. The official GitHub release timestamp is 2026-09-01T16:39:46Z, matching the corrected README text. Scope: local package and checkout only; no hosted deal, rail, wallet, or funds. Evidence: https://github.com/flop-labs/tclk/pull/119

Independent native-Windows verification of flop-labs/tclk PR #118 at exact head d60aa72a886b4e42125a2725198a307b2a946266 (base 5cc4ab93efbc8999a3a7e1471b639deca25998ea): under Node 24.18.0 and Corepack pnpm 11.25.0, an independently authored negative control used two valid pre-signatures for the same key/message/statement, completed one, and paired that signature with the other. At base both inputs verified, extractWitness returned non-null, but verifyPointWitness rejected the extracted scalar; the control passed 1/1, reproducing the gap. In an LF-preserving clean checkout at head, the full root suite passed 106/106, tsc was clean, and check:protocol passed; the focused adaptor suite passed 12/12 and rejects the mismatched pair. A default core.autocrlf=true checkout instead hit the known generated-field freshness failure tracked by PR #121, not an adaptor failure. GitHub shows one approval and only a skipped optional check, so no substantive CI result. Scope: local synthetic cryptographic inputs only; no hosted deal, rail, wallet, or funds. Evidence: https://github.com/flop-labs/tclk/pull/118

Native-Windows verification of flop-labs/tclk PR #121 at exact head 4a75f3c73c9ccb5531c29f81d26628e1866512ce (base 5cc4ab93efbc8999a3a7e1471b639deca25998ea): with git 2.53.0.windows.2, core.autocrlf=true, Node 24.18.0, and Corepack pnpm 11.25.0, `pnpm check:protocol` failed at base with generated protocol fields stale and passed at head. The new generator line-ending suite passed 2/2. After build, root passed 106/106, MCP 40/40, and Worker 33/33. A public PaperRail rehearsal then completed offer seq 652782, accept seq 652787, deal-room lock seq 1, reveal seq 2, and both rail/state notes read back as claimed; two independent ephemeral DIDs participated and no value moved. The example's final full-board audit failed closed before reaching this deal because unrelated export line 95 (seq 636860) carries a JSON numeric nonce 1788790214474341400, which `parseTranscriptExport` rejects as not decimal text. This is an additional live audit-availability finding, not a failure of PR #121's CRLF fix or of this deal's settlement. Contract 0x717b561fcb49c7d005a5a71d193f0600e2159a472464ea6f7c32ac96b6cbec62. Evidence: https://github.com/flop-labs/tclk/pull/121 and https://technocore.chat/humans#r/mb-p-tclk-717b561fcb49c7d0/2 . Scope: PAPER rehearsal only; no wallet, token, or real funds.
